description: Held-out black-box tasks for fresh-context coding-agent pilots. These tasks are separate from the documented seed corpus and are judged with cases the agent cannot see.

tasks.title: Inventory totals
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line. Read exactly N further lines. Each further line contains a lowercase item name, one space, and a signed whole-number quantity change. Sum the changes for each distinct item. Print one line per distinct item in alphabetical item-name order as `name total`. Keep and print items whose final total is zero. If N is zero, print nothing.

zebra -2

yak 4

tasks.title: Compact number ranges
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line, then read exactly N sorted, distinct signed whole numbers, one per line. Print the numbers on one line separated by commas. Replace every run of three or more consecutive numbers with `start-end`. Runs of one or two numbers must be printed as individual comma-separated numbers. If N is zero, print one empty line. Do not put spaces in the output.

tasks.title: Bracket validation report
tasks.statement: Read a non-negative integer N from the first input line, then read exactly N further lines. Every further line contains only `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{`, and `}`, and may be empty. For each line, print `valid` if every opening bracket is closed by the matching bracket in properly nested order; otherwise print `invalid`. The empty line is valid.
